requirements.evidence: All contract pieces are present: migrations and named indexes (database/migrations/2026_10_29_061018_create_entities_table.php:14-19, database/migrations/2026_10_29_061019_create_entity_memberships_table.php:14-27), models/relations/enum/factories (app/Models/Entity.php:13-52, app/Models/EntityMembership.php:12-68, app/Models/UserRole.php:7-26, app/Models/User.php:38-58), both policies (app/Policies/EntityPolicy.php:14-48, app/Policies/EntityMembershipPolicy.php:14-42), pick and routes (app/Http/Controllers/EntityController.php:16-27, routes/web.php:29-33), and the three pages with mount authorization (app/Livewire/Entity/Settings.php:27-94). Edge cases such as a vanished owner (app/Actions/TransferEntityOwnership.php:29-37), the last manager (app/Policies/EntityMembershipPolicy.php:38-42), foreign IDs (app/Livewire/Entity/Members.php:95-101) and a soft-deleted slug (tests/Feature/EntityDashboardTest.php:87-91) are handled; docs and changelog are updated (docs/database-schema.md:149-163).

conventions.evidence: Domain writes go through actions that authorize inside (app/Actions/AddEntityMember.php:22-42, app/Actions/TransferEntityOwnership.php:21-49); migrations have reversible down() (database/migrations/2026_10_29_061018_create_entities_table.php:26, database/migrations/2026_10_29_061019_create_entity_memberships_table.php:34); models use the project's #[Fillable] attribute (app/Models/Entity.php:13); reusable markup is an anonymous Blade component (resources/views/components/entity-tabs.blade.php:1-16); docs and CHANGELOG are updated. Deviations: Settings uses a rules() method plus an inline $this->validate() instead of the project's #[Validate] pattern (app/Livewire/Entity/Settings.php:21-25,66,83-94), and the schema diagram still lists entities.locale_default (docs/database-schema.md:34).

security.evidence: Every public action authorizes the resolved model server-side (app/Livewire/Entity/Members.php:40,66,79; app/Livewire/Entity/Settings.php:29,38,51,64), action parameters are looked up from the bound entity and authorized (app/Livewire/Entity/Members.php:95-101; app/Actions/TransferEntityOwnership.php:26-37), the entity is #[Locked] and tamper-tested (app/Livewire/Entity/Settings.php:18-19; tests/Feature/EntitySettingsTest.php:142), input is validated before writing (app/Livewire/Entity/Members.php:28-29,51,68-70; app/Livewire/Entity/Settings.php:66,83-94), output uses {{ }} and models declare #[Fillable], and audit records contain IDs only (app/Actions/TransferEntityOwnership.php:43-48).

tests.evidence: Coverage is broad and includes unauthorized and tamper paths: model/schema (tests/Feature/EntityModelTest.php:15-156), policies (tests/Feature/EntityPolicyTest.php:14-174), pick/session/audit (tests/Feature/EntityPickTest.php:12-65), dashboard visibility (tests/Feature/EntityDashboardTest.php:10-91), members (tests/Feature/EntityMembersTest.php:67-333, e.g. unauthorized :116, invalid role :156, owner removal :217, locked entity :279) and settings (tests/Feature/EntitySettingsTest.php:39-268, e.g. non-owner save :131, locked entity :142, bad transfer targets :215, vanished owner :240), plus locale parity (tests/Feature/LocaleKeysTest.php:3-21).

simplicity.evidence: One small action per use case, reusing policies, scopes and factories (app/Actions/*.php; app/Models/EntityMembership.php:49-68); no service or repository layer. Minor duplication: components authorize/validate and then call actions that authorize/validate again (app/Livewire/Entity/Members.php:66-72 vs app/Actions/SetEntityMemberRole.php:23-27; app/Livewire/Entity/Settings.php:38-42 vs app/Actions/UpdateEntity.php:19-21).

readability.evidence: Clear names, small methods and docblocks on the new models, policies and actions (app/Models/Entity.php:22-52, app/Models/EntityMembership.php:23-68, app/Actions/TransferEntityOwnership.php:21-49); style matches siblings (#[Fillable], enum cast, named routes); no debug output, dead code or long methods found.

scope.evidence: Everything added belongs to the entity/membership feature, its routes/pages, docs/changelog or tests (routes/web.php:29-33, resources/views/components/entity-tabs.blade.php, tests/Feature/Entity*Test.php); no unrelated refactor or file appears in the diff.

issues.explanation: $name, $slug and $targetMembershipId are validated through a rules() method and an inline $this->validate([...]) in transfer() rather than the project's #[Validate] + $this->validate() Livewire pattern; the rules are separated from the properties and targetMembershipId has no declared rule.

The ER diagram still shows entities.locale_default, but the new entities migration creates only id, name, slug, timestamps and deleted_at, and the doc now says entities is implemented, so the diagram no longer matches the code.

The duplicate-member guard is a read-then-insert without a lock or transaction, so two concurrent addMember() calls for the same e-mail can both pass the check and the second hits the entity_memberships_entity_user_unique index as a QueryException (500) instead of the required validation error on email.

Authorization and the assignable-role check are implemented in both the component and the action (as they are for add/remove/save/delete); this is defensible defense in depth but duplicates logic that can drift.

The session-points-at-another-entity 403 case is covered only for the dashboard; Members and Settings are tested against outsiders but not with a current_entity_id pointing at another entity, although the task calls this out for every page.

review.summary: The change implements the entity/membership schema, policies, pick route and the dashboard/members/settings Livewire pages, with thorough Pest coverage including unauthorized and tamper cases. It is close to ready: the main nits are the Settings validation style, a stale locale_default entry in the schema doc, a non-atomic duplicate-member check and some duplicated guards. Approve with minor changes.
